purpose: Teach: トレーダー/地蔵/グランプリ/怪獣/三昧/言うまでもなく/このごろ/スキン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、株のトレーダー、お客様にいたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, there was a stock trader who came in the other day.
lines.style: Bright, conversational opening. Leaning forward slightly with interest. Warm pace, like sharing something noticed. Natural gesture on 'stock trader.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の入り口に小さな地蔵を置いたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh? He mentioned that? We actually just put up a little stone statue by the entrance.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised. Pause just before the answer. Gentle delivery, like she's connecting something. Soft smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、映画のグランプリ作品、お客様が話してたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's nice. He was talking about some award-winning film earlier too.
lines.style: Attentive, following the thread of the conversation. Warm interest in what her friend is noticing. Steady, observant tone throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、怪獣映画の話で盛り上がってたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Right, he got really into discussing a monster film with me. We talked about it for ages.
lines.style: Animated recall. Slight laugh underneath. Quick energy on 'got really into.' Genuine pleasure in remembering the exchange.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、今週は新作読書三昧の日々よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's been such a week for me—just books, one after another. All the new releases.
lines.style: Softer, a little tired but content. Reflective pace. Slight trailing exhale like she's reviewing the week. Genuine affection for the busyness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、言うまでもなく、お客様第一よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Well, you know how it is—the customers always come first.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not unkind. Quiet certainty. Slight shrug in the voice. No complaint, just stating the obvious warmly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、このごろ寒くなってきたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's gotten colder these past few days, hasn't it?
lines.style: Observational, transitioning naturally to something practical. Soft, almost conversational. Like noticing the weather together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、スキンケアの相談、お客様からよく受けるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I've been getting a lot of customers asking for skincare advice lately. The cold makes everyone worried about their skin.
lines.style: Warm, gentle recognition. Slight laugh at the pattern. Animated but not rushed. Noticing and remembering her customers' needs.
